SessionStart.description: Export ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} into the session as ${MH_PLUGIN_ROOT} so skill markdown can reference bundled scripts portably.
Inject docs/METHODOLOGY.md whole into session context, plus python3/jq preflight notes.
Surface memory-lint findings (dangling links, orphans, index drift) at session start; silent when clean.

PreToolUse.description: Single PreToolUse entry point: fans out in parallel to every gate in hooks/pretooluse-table.json whose matcher matches, merges per Claude Code precedence (deny > defer > ask > allow). A gate that exceeds 8s is killed and counted as allow.

Stop.description: Track cumulative token and cost metrics per session; appends to ~/.local/share/kbg/metrics/costs.jsonl.
If the project's memory store is already a git repo (opt-in), commit any dirty changes for an audit trail. No-op otherwise.
